questions.text_as_printed: Explain the achievements of Firoz Shah. (Average)

answer.value:
Firuz Shah was a great ruler of the Bahmani dynasty.
He established an observatory in Daulatabad.
He enhanced the beauty of the capital, Kalaburagi (Gulbarga).
He built a new city called Firozabad on the banks of the Bhima River.
He granted several villages as endowments to the Sufi saint Bande Nawaz.
He paid special attention to the development of ports, which encouraged foreign trade.

questions.text_as_printed: Explain the achievements of Mahmud Gawan. (Difficult)

answer.value:
Achievements of Mahmud Gawan:
Gawan was skilled in warfare and expanded the kingdom.
The administration was based on Islamic laws.
He streamlined the revenue and postal systems.
He fixed land revenue based on soil fertility and irrigation facilities.
He abolished oppressive tax systems that harassed the people.
As a scholar himself, he founded a Madrasa in Bidar.
It housed three thousand manuscripts.
This encouraged Islamic and legal education.
Astronomy, mathematics, and history were studied there.
Students received free education and dormitory facilities.
